_help.total_grid_size_usdt: Total combined configured notional size of all active coin grids.
_help.current_grid_load_usdt: Current total notional position size across all active coin grids in USDT.
_help.max_grid_load_usdt: Historical maximum total notional position size reached in USDT.
_help.margin_load_pct: Current Margin Usage relative to floating account balance (%). (total_margin_used_usdt / cur_balance_usdt) * 100
_help.max_margin_load_pct: Historical Maximum Margin Usage relative to account balance (%).
_help.total_margin_used_usdt: Total margin currently locked in positions across all coins in USDT.
_help.max_margin_used_usdt: Historical maximum margin locked in positions in USDT.
_help.free_margin_usdt: Current available free margin in USDT (cur_balance_usdt - total_margin_used_usdt).
_help.free_margin_pct: Current free margin percentage of floating balance (%).
_help.min_free_margin_usdt: Historical minimum free margin in USDT reached.
_help.min_free_margin_pct: Historical minimum free margin percentage reached.
_help.recovery_factor: Recovery Factor. net_profit_usdt / abs(max_drawdown_usdt). Shows if the bots profit can cover historical max drawdowns.
_help.max_drawdown_net_usdt: [Per-Coin] Historical maximum drawdown of Net Profit (realized + floating).
_help.peak_net_profit_usdt: [Per-Coin] Highest Net Profit reached by this coin.
_help.realized_pnl_usdt: Total realized profit including commissions and funding fees from all closed trades.
_help.net_profit_usdt: realized_pnl_usdt + unrealized_pnl_usdt. The true mathematical growth of the account.
_help.unrealized_pnl_usdt: Current floating drawdown (unrealized PnL) of all open positions.
_help.performance_usdt: Maximum historical growth from start balance (peak - start_balance).
_help.avg_daily_profit: [Per-Coin] Average profit per active day of trading for this coin.
_help.max_position_size: [Per-Coin] Max historical notional size actually reached (total volume * price).
_help.max_net_profit: [Per-Coin] Historical maximum of the coin's fixed net profit.
_help.min_net_profit: [Per-Coin] Historical minimum of the coin's fixed net profit.
_help.max_drawdown: [Per-Coin] Historical maximum floating drawdown for this coin.
_help.min_drawdown: [Per-Coin] Historical minimum floating drawdown for this coin.
